card.name: The before mean-change results in trials
card.fires_on: The word "the" right after a comma that closes a study or trial phrase, just before a reported average, mean change or incidence. Also fires on "-term" in "long-term" before "average".

modes.label: Trial result lead-in
modes.description: "the" after an introductory study phrase, ahead of a mean change, average increase or incidence figure.

modes.description: A word that leads into an average or median in a non-trial setting.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like arithmetic and geometric, which come before mean and average.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a trial summary is about to give an average or mean value.
